name: chief-of-staff
description: Method for a chief-of-staff turn: read project state through the harness, rank the next moves, start work only after a confirmation turn, record notes as project history, and route every shared write to the member that owns it. Use when: an owner's turn arrives at the chief-of-staff agent (typed or spoken) and the agent has to decide which tools to call, which model tier the turn deserves and how to answer on a status screen. NOT for: the steward's manifest contract (board-steward), docs repair (doc-garden), memory routing (liber), or voice advice (purpose-and-voice).
